name: APEMAGA family() burns any address's balance without access control
summary: APEMAGA.family(address) had no access control and reduced the target's balance, so 55 minutes after deployment the attacker called it three times on the APEMAGA/WETH pair, synced the collapsed reserve, and sold a small pre-bought position for the pair's WETH.
notes: Loss is the pair's WETH; its burned APEMAGA is valued at nothing (rule 12).
